notes.summary: These questions test speed and accuracy: spotting identical names, addresses, numbers or dates, and reading letters from a number matrix. Usually 0–1 question.

concepts.title: Identical pairs
concepts.body: Compare in small chunks (3–4 characters at a time). Watch for swapped digits (4471 / 4417), changed vowels (Kumar / Kumer) and changed punctuation.

concepts.title: Matrix indexing
concepts.body: Each letter is given by row number first, then column number. For "27", go to row 2, column 7. A letter that appears twice in a matrix can have more than one code.

varieties.name: Identical pairs / address match
varieties.how: Compare each pair chunk by chunk; count only exact matches.

varieties.name: Matrix indexing
varieties.how: For each number, read row then column; check every letter of the word.

example.q: In a matrix, row 2 column 7 is T. What does 27 represent?

tips: Use your finger or pen to move across both items together.
In matrix questions, check the odd-looking option first; usually one number points to a wrong letter.
traps: Swapped digits and similar spellings (Kamla / Kamala) are the most common traps.
Do not read column first: the row number always comes first.

questions.q:
How many of the following pairs are exactly the same?
(1) 4573821 – 4573821
(2) Rajesh Kumar – Rajesh Kumer
(3) 12/09/2025 – 12/09/2025
(4) MNOPQ – MNOQP
questions.solution:
(1) Same.
(2) Kumar vs Kumer: different.
(3) Same.
(4) MNOPQ vs MNOQP: P and Q swapped, different.
So 2 pairs are the same.

questions.q:
Which option is exactly the same as the given address?
Anil Sharma, 24/B, Gandhi Nagar, Jaipur – 302015
questions.solution:
(a) PIN 302051 ≠ 302015.
(b) Exactly the same.
(c) Sarma ≠ Sharma.
(d) 42/B ≠ 24/B.

questions.q:
A word is represented by a set of numbers. Each letter is given by its row number followed by its column number in the matrix below. Which set represents the word MAP?
56789
0STARE
1MONET
2RATIO
3PLANS
4EMITS
A form shows a date of birth as 05-11-1998 (DD-MM-YYYY). Which of the following is the same date?
questions.solution:
DD = 05, MM = 11, YYYY = 1998.
Month 11 = November.
So the date is 5 November 1998.

questions.q:
Each letter is given by its row number followed by its column number in the matrix below. Which set does NOT represent the word RAT?
56789
0STARE
1MONET
2RATIO
3PLANS
4EMITS
questions.solution:
R = 08 or 25; A = 07, 26 or 37; T = 06, 19, 27 or 48.
(a) R, A, T ✓. (b) R, A, T ✓. (c) R, A, T ✓.
(d) 36 = row 3, column 6 = L, not T. So (d) does not represent RAT.

questions.q:
In how many of the following pairs are both entries exactly the same?
(1) 8920436 – 8920436
(2) Kamla Devi – Kamala Devi
(3) Plot 7/C, Sector 12 – Plot 7/C, Sector 21
(4) PQ-4471-ZX – PQ-4471-ZX
(5) 23.05.2019 – 23.05.2019
questions.solution:
(1) Same. (2) Kamla vs Kamala: different. (3) Sector 12 vs 21: different. (4) Same. (5) Same.
So 3 pairs are the same.

flashcards.back: Compare in chunks of 3–4 characters; watch swapped digits.
